title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #17

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Who was the king of Ayodhya in the Ramayan? (1 mark)
   A. Hiranyakashipu
   B. Dasharatha
   C. Suddhodana
   D. Harishchandra

2. Which leaves are offered to Shiva on Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. Tea leaves
   B. Tulsi leaves only
   C. Banana leaves
   D. Bel (bilva) leaves

3. What is a jagaran or vigil? (1 mark)
   A. Staying awake at night to pray and sing
   B. A meal
   C. Eating a big meal
   D. A race

4. Which element is called Vayu? (1 mark)
   A. Air
   B. Fire
   C. Earth
   D. Space

5. What promise lesson do we learn from the Ayodhya Kaand? (1 mark)
   A. Keep your promises
   B. Forget promises
   C. Promises are for kings only
   D. Break promises

6. What should be written when an item is put in the lost and found? (1 mark)
   A. A secret code
   B. The date and the finder's name
   C. Nothing
   D. The price

7. What does the Kiswahili word Madaraka mean? (1 mark)
   A. Freedom of religion
   B. Power or authority to govern
   C. Peace
   D. Food

8. Which action follows a Sikh teaching? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing lunch with someone who has none
   B. Teasing the child
   C. Hiding your lunch
   D. Keeping it all

9. Why is it a mistake to say there are four elements in the Panch Mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. There are seven
   B. There are five
   C. There are ten
   D. There is only one

10. How do you show integrity in a test? (1 mark)
   A. Look in your bag
   B. Whisper answers
   C. Copy from a neighbour
   D. Do your own work

11. Which is a common mistake? (1 mark)
   A. Being kind to animals
   B. Being honest
   C. Praying
   D. Thinking Dharma is only for grown-ups

12. Who first compiled Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Ram Das Ji
   B. Valmiki
   C. Guru Arjan Dev Ji
   D. Mahavir

13. How many days are in the week in the Indian traditional calendar? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. Seven
   C. Five
   D. Eight

14. What is aarti? (1 mark)
   A. Painting
   B. Reading a map
   C. Eating
   D. Waving a lamp in front of the murti while singing

15. What did Siddhartha later become? (1 mark)
   A. The Buddha, the Awakened One
   B. A Jain Tirthankar
   C. A Sikh Guru
   D. An Avtar of Vishnu

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. List three ideal practices of a passenger while travelling. (3 marks)

17. Write the Indian names for Tuesday and Wednesday. (2 marks)

18. Name the two Ramayan kaands studied in this lesson. (2 marks)

19. Describe how to sit in Vajra Asana. (3 marks)

20. Name the two Jain scriptures in this lesson. (2 marks)

21. Explain the main teachings of the Dhammapada. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Dasharatha
   King Dasharatha ruled Ayodhya.

2. D — Bel (bilva) leaves
   Bel leaves are offered.

3. A — Staying awake at night to pray and sing
   Devotees stay awake.

4. A — Air
   Vayu means air and wind.

5. A — Keep your promises
   Ram kept his father's promise.

6. B — The date and the finder's name
   The book keeps a record.

7. B — Power or authority to govern
   It means authority to govern.

8. A — Sharing lunch with someone who has none
   Sharing with others is a Sikh teaching.

9. B — There are five
   Panch means five.

10. D — Do your own work
   Doing your own work is honest.

11. D — Thinking Dharma is only for grown-ups
   Children can practise Dharma too.

12. C — Guru Arjan Dev Ji
   Guru Arjan Dev Ji was the fifth Guru.

13. B — Seven
   Seven days.

14. D — Waving a lamp in front of the murti while singing
   It is a prayer with a lamp.

15. A — The Buddha, the Awakened One
   Siddhartha became the Buddha.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wear the seat belt, sit still, keep hands and head inside, keep the aisle clear, do not litter, do not distract the driver, give up your seat (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tuesday: Mangalvaar. Wednesday: Budhvaar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Bal Kaand and Ayodhya Kaand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kneel with knees together, bring big toes close, sit back on your heels, keep the back and head straight and place palms on the thighs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three correct steps.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kalpasutra and Uttaradhyayan Sutra.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Our thoughts shape our actions, hatred is ended by love, control of anger is strength, and doing good brings peace.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each teaching, up to 3.
